diagnosis: CustomPasswordResetConfirmView overrides post() to handle password updates directly from request.POST, but completely omits invoking self.token_generator.check_token(user, token). Any unauthenticated user who encodes a target user's primary key into base64 can reset that target user's password without needing a valid reset token.
